mixerMetadata.note: Cue assets remain unity gain/pitch. These are existing browser mixer settings for a port adapter, not DSP baked into imported Unreal assets.

eventVariation.roundRobin: Full shuffled bag, every take once before refill; boundary swap prevents immediate last-take repetition. UI and score unchanged.
eventVariation.bakedLayerSelection: All20 families have8 unique takes and >=2 actual source-layer combinations. PDC layer selection is baked, never stacked. V7 seven guided phase/motor families also each8 unique physical takes and >=2 actual source-layer combinations.

spatialPolicy.sizeUnits: game hull length; unitsToCentimeters100 applies native distances
spatialPolicy.PDCSizeModulation: fixed30 to preserve calibrated short burst weight

guidedMotorPolicy.lifetime: Strict motorActive===true only. Evaluate guided routes every audio.update frame, independent of100ms score/hull cadence.12ms powered gain attack; cancel stale automation and fade4ms/stop18ms on actual coast/done/generation/map/remote/pause. Brief correction and heavy terminal pulses resume motor only, never first ignition.
guidedMotorPolicy.filter: Existing near filter unchanged; heavy distance>1000 additionally caps lowpass at360*(distance/1000)^(-.20)Hz. No additional loops; two nearest actually powered eligible bodies total.

damageObservation.breach: Read actual campaignUnit.damageControl.sections (or ship.damageControl.sections) breach counts; visual holes cap at6 and can remain after patch. Observe new increases only, no restored-save startup reports; legacy visual-count fallback only without compartment state. Never modify damage.
damageObservation.vent: At most2 nearest live local hulls whose actual section breaches>0 and pressure>.025. Finite1.8s releases gated1.8s; patch, repair or depressurization stops new releases. Legacyfallback requires visual breaches and hp<95% only if no section state.

guidedPhasePolicy.dedup: Audio-owned WeakMap keyed object identity plus guidedGeneration; first cold release and first ignition only. Coast correction never replays ignition. Old flying objects discovered from load/view do not invent launch reports. Consume remote/paused transitions without delayed replay. Callback timing authoritative;Per-frame observer fallback supports older callbackless bodies.
guidedPhasePolicy.lifetime: Cold report keeps its finite physical decay. Ignition voices retain projectile+guidedGeneration and are gated every frame by strict motorActive===true, !done, !launchPending, matching generation and local running system. On coast/done/reuse/pause/map/remote cancel stale gain automation and fade4ms/stop18ms. Callback occurs before motor flag is updated in same simulation step; frame gate consumes authoritative final powered state. Do not replay first ignition on correction/terminal burns.

swarmWallPolicy.position: centroid of actually burning local swarm bodies within1000
swarmWallPolicy.stop: Strict currently powered local swarm count<3, coast/done/remote/map/pause; cancel stale automation then fade4ms/stop18ms.12ms powered attack; sync each audio.update frame.
swarmWallPolicy.loopContract: Spawn once, update bounded density/pan/filter, retain native component while burning, stop on lifetime end. Score transport unchanged.

longRangeReceiver.observer: Read world.galactic.radarContacts plus campaign.contacts confidence/identified/uncertainty; only live local actually rendered radar reports sound. Hidden designer transitions consumed; no hidden coordinates read. Optional world.solarIntel() supplies only actually activated disclosed/observed, precise, matching-system scans with finite position, startedAt and duration evaluated against authoritative simulation time. Explicit disclosed:false fails closed.
longRangeReceiver.coalesce: Actual ping/sweep takes one shared report slot and consumes same-tick contact transitions; never queue fleet-sized reports. Suppress restored/save/view/pause scan baselines, repeated IDs, late disclosure, future/expired scans and confidence jitter. Scan ID uses system/emitter/mode/startedAt. Receiver reports consume legacy contact:ui even when full voice pool; successful ACTIVE PING toast has no generic confirm before the actual emission. Actual solar uncertainty preserved; uncertainty drift threshold max(28m,20% of best prior solution).
longRangeReceiver.voicePolicy: Priority0, at most existing64 pool; reports never steal a gun voice; skip while Alerts0/masterMute; no new oscillator/timer/assets.
longRangeReceiver.music: sensorTension<=.55, rise2.5s/release5s; contribution=tension*max(0,1-combatIntensity/.35); existing score-pulse +.18*contribution, danger +.10*contribution, bed LP -350*contribution. Existing Music/master/mute and duck buses retain control.

solarAudioPolicy.source: world.solarIntel() authoritative read-only disclosed current-system frame; not hidden ships or drive-signature correlation

notes: Only banks actually referenced by pass-four recipes, loops or tails are included. Unused older preload banks are excluded.
Spatial near/far are source game units; generator converts to centimeters. Non-positional cues use a valid dummy range with attenuation disabled.
radio-intercept is the speech bank; intercept alias is the physical interception impact event.
Runtime aliases identify banks; category/recipe gain, pitch, layered squelch and conditional hull tails remain runtime mixer behavior.
V5 changes only PDC articulation/voice masking. All v4 heavy weapons, master calibration .69 and user preferences retained. Native adapter should mirror pdcPolicy; raw cues retain unity gain.

Pass9 adds state-driven receiver ECM and powered supply traffic via existing shipboard/hb-drive-small/hb-drive-medium cues. Cue specs, variants, keys, aliases, licence records and waveform hashes are byte-identical to pass8; host instance/routing/lifetime metadata only, no UE reimport required. WebAudio 321 buffers unchanged. No live/capture/native-host playback claim: root owns actual integration/proof.
